Rewrite so_that/landing to state why a customer buying output rather than equity does not count toward the '>=2 operator-co-led $100M+ rounds' bar, or widen the bar to admit it. This is new since the 2026-07-26 fresh verdict, which was issued before the 07-28 bridge existed.
